today.note: PARLAY combined_odds are exact (independent cross-game legs). SGP combined_odds are RAW MULTIPLIED estimates — same-game legs correlate and the book applies a discount not in the per-leg data. SGP+ is EV-optimized across >=2 games (more dispersed = lower shared failure risk, higher all-legs-hit probability); its odds are still flagged estimate because it may include same-game legs that correlate.
today.hr_note: HR plays come from SimpleOdds' own Dinger Report model. edge_pct = modelProb - impliedProb. is_bet is SimpleOdds' own recommended flag. Graded separately from parlays.
